description: Long-term knowledge approved by user for retention across projects

entries.summary: Always generate patches for code changes in SAFE_MODE
entries.detail: When SAFE_MODE=true (default), never modify application source code directly. Generate unified diffs or git-format-patch files under .github/patches/ and create draft PRs for review. This prevents accidental breaking changes and maintains auditability.

entries.summary: Scan for secrets before any file write or commit
entries.detail: Before writing any file, scan content for high-entropy strings (threshold: 4.5+) and patterns like 'api_key', 'password', 'secret', 'token', 'dsn'. If detected, redact and create remediation instructions. Never commit secrets to repository.
